title: Insufficient Granularity of Access Control in AMD Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) firmware could allow an…
description: CVE-2025-54504 is a medium severity vulnerability in AMD Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) firmware. It involves insufficient granularity of access control that could allow an attacker with administrative privileges to write to a trusted region used by SEV-Encrypted State (SEV-ES). This may result in loss of integrity of the protected state.
